description: This Java class acts as a command handler for updating financial activity account mappings within the Fineract accounting module. It processes commands and delegates the update operation to the write platform service.

classes.name: UpdateFinancialActivityAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update commands for financial activity accounts, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and using the FinancialActivityAccountWritePlatformService to perform updates.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by extracting the entity ID and delegating the update operation to the write platform service.
